scriptData.label: @effect.name
Roll to remove Stunned

description.label: Description
description.value:
You twist around to dodge the hail of fragments, which still catches you on the back of the shoulder. Multiple pellets strip the flesh from your shoulder blade, spattering the side of your face with shreds of flesh and spent fragments!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (2) and @Condition[Bleeding] (2). Roll randomly for side, right or left – the arm on that side suffers a Torn Muscle (Minor).
